capSemanticsReview.rationale: The complete immutable SavingsXDai/ERC4626 source requires deposit() and mint() to transfer the computed WXDAI assets into the vault before minting shares. There is no wrapper-local privileged mint, minter authorization, cap setter, price setter, upgrade or asset-allocation path. maxDeposit/maxMint are permissionless uint256-max limits, not an administrator's unbacked issuance power. The bound is deposit-backed construction, not a finite lifetime supply ceiling. Upstream xDAI bridge issuance and Sky exposure remain inherited through the xdai-gnosis serial claim rather than a second local mint charge.

controls.evidence: Complete SavingsXDai, ERC4626 and ERC20 source census finds only user deposits/mints backed by transferred WXDAI; no local owner, role administrator, privileged share mint, cap setter, pause, seizure, upgrade or strategy allocator exists. The immutable asset and current runtime are corroborated at Gnosis block 48768019. Permissionless maxDeposit/maxMint return uint256 maximum, but neither creates unbacked shares or an administrator able to raise an issuance cap. Upstream bridge interest distribution changes assets per share, not privileged share issuance.

review.evidence: At Gnosis block 48768019 (2026-10-15T10:43:10Z), https://rpc.gnosischain.com returned the fixed WXDAI asset, a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot and runtime whose SHA256 over the 0x-prefixed hex string is 3a090cb03bc4708c50986acd44093c4b5220646139a0229bad1e12fb2aabecef. owner() reverted; this is only corroboration, not proof of absence by itself. The complete verified SavingsXDai and imported ERC4626/ERC20 source positively establishes deposit-backed share minting with no privileged local mint, cap expansion or upgrade path. Parent xDAI control is inherited and is not treated as absent.
